goal: Connect an immediately playable experiment to an explanation, editable Playground code and the existing npm embedding example, preserving source readability and primary references.
scope: One original held Saw C3, optional C3/E3/G3 chord; one 6581 PAL approximation at a time.
Bypass/LP/BP/HP, 11-bit Cutoff code, four-bit Resonance, individual routes into one shared filter.
Fixed-scale live Spectrum; display/current Playground source and copied JavaScript track controls.
Explicit user-gesture Start/Stop and cleanup; no autoplay.

primaryReferences.title: Original MOS/Commodore 6581 datasheet scan
claims: LP/BP/HP outputs and additive mode combinations

importantDistinctions: Bypass is mode off with routing0; mode off with routed voices silences those routed outputs.
Cutoff is a hardware code, not a universal or linear Hz value.
Output levels are not normalized across modes; Resonance can also change level.
Chip controls are distinguished from UI/note-name/chord helpers, fixed host gain0.35, transport fade and spectrum analysis.
The page holds until Stop; copied source runs4seconds then releases0.4seconds and disposes. Host Master/Mixer may differ.
The Synth link opens a separate editor and does not claim automatic setting transfer.

coverage: Actual 44100/48000Hz finite nonzero output for all4modes
Live filter edits touch shared registers only, preserving voice pitch/Gates
Relative harmonic distribution and Resonance changes
Dirty inherited state resets to original patch
Published code executes/disposes correctly and both language defaults match

webkitRetirement.beforeFailure: A real WebKit context reported running again immediately after close resolved closed, with no late Worklet or voice.
webkitRetirement.fix: Owner-specific retired-context statechange guard serializes re-close requests; a late resume observer only touches the retired context.
webkitRetirement.after: All16contexts in final4paths closed; additional8contexts in boundedWebKitrepeat closed with zero errors.

tests.workflow: Interactive introductions: Node examples and muted Chromium/WebKit checks; YAML parsed locally. Remote Actions not triggered.

distribution: Static docs page and original ES modules; uses existing served SID assets. Existing Synth/Playground itch ZIPs do not contain the introduction pages and need no new dependency copy for this chapter.
limits: 6581 digital approximation, not a calibrated analog SID/speaker comparison.
Hearing/subjective timbre has not been evaluated through physical audio output.
Model comparison, Sync/Ring and historical game-file investigation are follow-up chapters.
